q1.explanationZh: brick 名词“砖”，可数，复数 bricks。

q3.explanationZh: bridegroom = bride（新娘）+ groom，意为“新郎”。

q4.explanationZh: bridge 名词“桥”，动词“架桥；弥合”，如 bridge the gap“弥合差距”。

q5.explanationZh: brief 形容词“简短的”，名词“摘要”，动词“向……介绍情况”；in brief“简言之”。

q6.explanationZh: brigade“（执行特定任务的）队”，fire brigade“消防队”。

q7.explanationZh: bright 形容词“明亮的；聪明的”，动词形式 brighten。

q8.explanationZh: brilliant“才华横溢的；灿烂的”，注意双写 l。

q9.explanationZh: bring“带来”，过去式和过去分词都是 brought。

q10.explanationZh: broad“宽的；广泛的”，动词 broaden“（使）变宽”。

q11.explanationZh: broadcast = broad + cast，动词、名词同形，过去式和过去分词也是 broadcast。

q14.explanationZh: brow“额头；眉毛”，mop one’s brow“擦前额”。

q15.explanationZh: brown 形容词“棕色的”，也可作名词“棕色”。

q16.explanationZh: browse“随便翻阅；浏览”，常用 browse among/through books。

q18.explanationZh: brush 名词“刷子”，动词“刷”，brush one’s teeth“刷牙”。

q19.explanationZh: BS 是 Bachelor of Science 的缩写，“理学士”，两个字母都大写。

q20.explanationZh: bubble 名词“泡”，动词“冒泡”，注意双写 b。

q22.explanationZh: budget 名词“预算”，动词“编入预算”，注意中间的 d。

q23.explanationZh: buffet“自助餐”，结尾 t 不发音。

q24.explanationZh: bug“虫子”，也指电脑程序的“漏洞”，fix the bug“修复漏洞”。

q25.explanationZh: build 动词“建造；发展”，过去式和过去分词是 built；名词“体格”。

q26.explanationZh: build 加 -ing 构成名词 building“建筑物”。

q28.explanationZh: bull“公牛”，as strong as a bull“壮得像头牛”。

q30.explanationZh: bully 动词“欺负”，名词“仗势欺人者”，复数 bullies，过去式 bullied。

q32.explanationZh: bunch“束，串”，a bunch of flowers“一束花”。

q33.explanationZh: burden 名词“负荷；重负”，动词“加负荷于”，如 the traffic burden“交通压力”。

q34.explanationZh: burn“燃烧”，过去式和过去分词是 burnt 或 burned。

q35.explanationZh: fire brigade“消防队”，brigade 指执行特定任务的队。

q36.explanationZh: bring sth. to an end“使某事结束”，省略号处放宾语。

q37.explanationZh: bring sb. to life“使某人苏醒”，也可说 bring sb. back to life。

q38.explanationZh: bring about“引起，导致”，后接名词，如 bring about changes。

q39.explanationZh: bring up“抚养；提出”，过去分词 brought up。

q40.explanationZh: mop one’s brow“擦前额”，brow 指额头。

accept: browse among books in the public library
browsing among books in the public library

q41.explanationZh: browse among books“在书中随便翻阅”，“在公共图书馆”= in the public library。

q42.explanationZh: BS 是 Bachelor of Science（理学士）的缩写。

q43.explanationZh: a bucket of + 名词“一桶……”。

q44.explanationZh: build up“建立，树立；增强”，如 build up one’s confidence。

q45.explanationZh: change a bulb“换灯泡”，bulb 是可数名词。

q46.explanationZh: bump into“撞上；偶然碰见”，into 是介词。

q47.explanationZh: burn down“烧毁”，多指建筑物被烧光。

q48.explanationZh: burn sth. out“烧完；熄灭”，指燃料烧尽后熄灭。

q50.explanationZh: bump against“撞上”，in the dark 描述过去发生的事，用过去式 bumped。

q51.explanationZh: is + 现在分词表示正在进行，bubble 去 e 加 -ing 为 bubbling“冒泡，沸腾”。

q52.explanationZh: change from green to brown“由绿变棕”，brown 在这里作名词“棕色”。

q53.explanationZh: are being done 是被动语态的进行时，bully 变 y 为 i 加 -ed：bullied。

q54.explanationZh: the top of the building“大楼的顶部”，冠词 the 后用名词 building。

q55.explanationZh: twin brother“双胞胎兄弟”，his 后用单数 brother。

q56.explanationZh: fire brigade“消防队”，是固定搭配。

q57.explanationZh: bring about“引起，带来”，has + 过去分词 brought 构成现在完成时。

q58.explanationZh: increase the budget“增加预算”，the 后用名词 budget。

q59.explanationZh: 与复数 brides 并列，用复数 bridegrooms“新郎们”。

q60.sampleAnswer: These vitamins B and C help to build up your resistance to diseases.
references: These vitamins B and C help to build up your resistance to diseases.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “有助于做某事”= help to do sth.；“增强抵抗力”= build up one’s resistance；“对疾病的抵抗力”= resistance to diseases。

q61.sampleAnswer: The key laboratory will sign cooperation agreements with local vocational schools, which will bring students an unusual interactive experience.
references: The key laboratory will sign cooperation agreements with local vocational schools, which will bring students an unusual interactive experience.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “为学生提供……体验”可用 bring sb. sth.“给某人带来某物”；用 which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。

q62.sampleAnswer: If the brides-to-be think that the wedding dress is the top priority, they have to cut expenses on other items to avoid overspending the wedding budget.
references: If the brides-to-be think that the wedding dress is the top priority, they have to cut expenses on other items to avoid overspending the wedding budget.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “准新娘”= brides-to-be，复数加在 bride 上；“重中之重”= the top priority；“以防……”= to avoid doing。

q63.sampleAnswer: One of his hobbies is to browse among the books in a second-hand bookshop.
references: One of his hobbies is to browse among the books in a second-hand bookshop.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “……之一”= one of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 is；“翻看书籍”= browse among the books；“旧书店”= a second-hand bookshop。

q64.sampleAnswer: After a week of rain, the weather turned sunny and bright, which was truly delightful.
references: After a week of rain, the weather turned sunny and bright, which was truly delightful.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “变得”= turn + 形容词；“晴朗明媚”= sunny and bright；“这真令人愉悦”用 which 引导的非限制性定语从句。

q65.sampleAnswer: The radio station sets up an overseas broadcast program.
references: The radio station sets up an overseas broadcast program.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “设置”= set up；broadcast 作定语修饰 program，“海外广播节目”= an overseas broadcast program。

q66.sampleAnswer: It is said that this doctor is able to bring the dying back to life.
references: It is said that this doctor is able to bring the dying back to life.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “据说”= It is said that...；“起死回生”= bring the dying back to life，the dying 指“垂死的人”。

q67.sampleAnswer: Born and brought up in the countryside, he is interested in biology.
references: Born and brought up in the countryside, he is interested in biology.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “出生并成长”用过去分词短语 Born and brought up 作状语，bring up 的过去分词是 brought up；“对……感兴趣”= be interested in。

q68.sampleAnswer: It is time to take action to control the quantity of (the) private cars so as to relieve the traffic burden during the rush hours.
references: It is time to take action to control the quantity of (the) private cars so as to relieve the traffic burden during the rush hours.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “是时候做某事”= It is time to do sth.；“交通压力”= the traffic burden；“以便”= so as to。

q69.sampleAnswer: We should learn a lesson from this incident: He who plays with fire will surely get burnt.
references: We should learn a lesson from this incident: He who plays with fire will surely get burnt.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “吸取教训”= learn a lesson from；“玩火者必自焚”= He who plays with fire will surely get burnt，get burnt 表示“被烧伤”。
